content.text:
h13.

**impl** — One concrete implementation executes at runtime: the unexported struct `service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`), which implements the `markdown.Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`). It wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` engine (using the `github.com/yuin/goldmark` library) plus the repo's custom tag/mention extensions. There are no mock/no-op/alternate implementations — every call site (production and tests) uses this same concrete `service`.

**construction** — Instances are built only via `markdown.NewService(opts...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), which returns `&service{...}`. It is called at:
- `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` — inside `NewAPIV1Service`, the production wiring, configured with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()`. This single instance is created once and shared.
- `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` — test-only construction of the same concrete type.

**holders** — Components holding the `markdown.Service` interface (as a field/param):
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — field at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`; used in `memo_service.go:108,447`, `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`.
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — field at `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`; constructed via `NewRSSService(...)` (`rss.go:58`) at `server/server.go:85`, which passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` (i.e., the same shared instance). Used at `rss.go:339`.
